title_as_printed: Table 7. Determined CO2 Solubility in the NaCl Solution (b = 2 mol kg-1) at Temperatures from 303.15 to 353.15 K and Pressures from 3.0 to 30.0 MPa (printed with 'a' footnote; units mol.kg-1 as mol kg-1)

footnotes_as_printed.a: Standard uncertainties u are u(T) = 0.01 K, u(P) = 0.039 MPa, and u(b) = 0.0005 b, and the uncertainties of CO2 solubility are estimated based on the average deviation of five measurements of Raman peak height ratio for each measurement at the T and P condition.

pressure_note: Pressure of the CO2-water system in the equilibrium vessel/capillary (P/MPa, u(P) = 0.039 MPa); the paper does not say whether it is total pressure or CO2 partial pressure, and gives no water-vapour correction

value.what: CO2 solubility determined from the Raman nu(CO2)/nu(H2O) peak height ratio via a calibration curve (CO2 concentration vs ratio)

uncertainty.what: estimated from the average deviation of five Raman peak-height-ratio measurements at each T,P

mol_basis_note: Header says CO2 solubility/mol kg-1; basis per kg of what is not explicitly stated (taken to mean kg of solvent/water by the paper's use of molality for NaCl); volume basis not applicable
conversion_needs: kg basis (water vs solution) of the CO2 solubility not explicitly stated
notes: Wide layout (six temperature columns, each cell 'value +- uncertainty') restacked to long form by script: temperature blocks 303.15 to 353.15 K in order, pressures in printed order within each block. Printed rows 17 x 6 temperatures = 102 CSV rows. Printed pressure steps are irregular above 13.5 MPa. In Table 7 one printed uncertainty has four decimals (0.0077, 313.15 K, 4.0 MPa); kept as printed. No standard conditions for gas volumes: not used.
